Read data pasted into a text box

Source: R/read_input.R
read_pasted.Rd

Accepts a block of text copied from a spreadsheet, which arrives tab-separated, or typed as comma-separated values. The separator is detected from the header line, because a laboratory pasting from Excel should not have to know or care which it is.

Usage

read_pasted(text)

Arguments

text

A single string containing the pasted block.

Value

A data frame.

Examples

read_pasted("conc,young\n0,27\n0,30\n1.56,32")
#>   conc young
#> 1 0.00    27
#> 2 0.00    30
#> 3 1.56    32
